reviews.title: Great premium AIO option for aesthetics and performance.
reviews.comment: I purchased the NZXT Kraken Elite 360 RGB CPU AIO Cooler as a part of a new higher end PC build that I was planning and it was a perfect fit for it! I will start off by saying this is a bit more of a premium AIO compared to some of the newer CHEAPER models by other brands, but this is definitely still a very solid choice especially for an aesthetically pleasing build. The Kraken Elite was very easy to set up in a PC build, (given you are following the manual or a youtube tutorial) coming with everything you need including screws and allowing you to mount the fans to the radiator yourself. I personally decided to mount mine on the top of the case and it was a pretty good fit as it allows the fans to be exhaust, pushing hot air out of the radiator and out of the chassis. The pre-applied thermal paste on the copper plate was definitely a great touch as it would allow for beginners to minimize mistakes with applying that. The Cooling on this AIO is definitely very efficient, generally keeping temps under 60-70°C under load for my R7 9800x3d which is described to run hotter, the Kraken Elite handles it extremely well. The pump & fans seem to be very quiet and doesnt cause any noise issues even at higher speeds, it handles it very well and even better with the Zero RPM Mode. Now when it comes to aesthetics, this thing definitely shines with its premium LCD Screen at 2.7inch IPS at 640x640 allowing for endless ideas of image/gif customization and the ability to show real-time system stats on top of that. Of course being done with the NZXT Cam software which has given me little to no issues at all! The NZXT Cam software is very straightforward and easy to customize your rig, especially if you are pairing other NZXT fans with the AIO, it allows for different RGB modes and separate profiles and tweaking of fan performance and so much more! With all of that being said I definitely recommend the NZXT Kraken Elite AIO for anyone that feels it will fit nicely into their PC build and is willing to pay the premium price for the quality product.
reviews.author: Sam Hollister

reviews.title: Would recommend to Anyone!
reviews.comment: Excellent Item, peak performance with fine tuning of fan speed, mounts in a breeze, and has very compatible connection with a multitude of software. Certainly, came at a solid price for the reliance. A notable detail, the three 120mm fans are combined into a single unit, mounted with only 4 screws in the corners. They are not separate fans! Also, all aspects of this product are white, but the screws are black if that's important to anyone.

reviews.title: Spend the extra get this
reviews.comment: Your going to love this🤍 Pros: 💗 Easy Installation – Comes with pre-applied thermal paste and brackets for both Intel and AMD, making setup hassle-free. 💗 Quiet Operation – Runs silently even under load, ensuring minimal noise disruption. 💗 RGB Customization – Features vibrant RGB lighting, allowing for personalization to match your setup. 💗 Efficient Cooling – Delivers excellent thermal performance, keeping CPU temperatures in check. Cons: ❌ Premium Price – Slightly expensive compared to other AIO coolers. The NZXT Kraken Elite RGB is a fantastic choice for those looking for an easy-to-install, silent, and visually appealing AIO cooler. While it may come at a premium, the build quality, cooling efficiency, and stunning RGB effects make it a solid investment for PC enthusiasts.
reviews.author: HispanicTitanic

reviews.title: NZXT Kraken Elite 420 RGB – Supreme Cooling Meets Stunning Design
reviews.comment: The NZXT Kraken Elite 420 RGB is an absolute powerhouse in liquid cooling. Its performance is phenomenal, keeping even heavily overclocked CPUs at impressively low temperatures while remaining whisper-quiet under load. The sleek, modern design combined with customizable RGB lighting makes it a stunning centerpiece in any build. Installation is straightforward, and the build quality feels premium and durable. Whether for high-end gaming, content creation, or extreme overclocking, this cooler delivers top-tier performance and aesthetics. It truly sets the standard for what a high-end AIO cooler should be.
